title: ANT/ENT Words (15s micro-cut)
voice_notes: Remix variant — reuses lesson-05-ant-ent audio via explicit segment keys. No new TTS.

segments.say: English has hidden Spanish words all over it. Here is one pattern.
Words ending in ant or ent often become Spanish by adding e.
Important becomes importante. Different becomes diferente.

caption: English words ending in ant/ent often become Spanish by adding e: importante, constante, excelente.
